chapter: Averty's letters and Tom Brown's claims
title: Brown's account of Lamb's Cafe and the name 'jazz', and Averty's critique
summary: Brown's quoted account of Lamb's Cafe in 1915, the union and the word jazz, his tour, claims about Tiger Rag; Averty's analysis begins.
